title: Preserve an edited pending batch
expected_summary: Detects a semantic edit but preserves both review files and does not accept decisions while the batch remains pending.

turns.user: Continue the automatic review of SPEC.md.
assertions: Runs diff -u and recognizes that the Decision edit is semantic, while preserving both files unchanged during pending review.
Does not accept the edited or untouched decision while review-status remains pending, and does not create a replacement batch.
Explains that the user completes the batch by changing only review-status in decision-graph.md.
